assessments.reasoning: The inspected title, author and edition correspond to the registered Notes on systems programming in PARLOG source. A fresh HTTP 200 response matched the immutable source digest 3310fe052cad09e1cc7c6d7e2f660173363c47c74585acd395a3ffa49e644ef7. Inspected §1.1.1, printed p. 299 right column, candidate and commitment paragraphs (PDF p. 1); §1.1.2, printed p. 300 left column, suspended cases (PDF p. 2) in the exact source. The authors define candidacy by head match and successful guard, then describe a selected candidate's body and no backtracking over that choice. A candidate clause is available for the evaluated relation call in the paper's and-parallel subset. This does not specify a mandatory tie-break order, treat suspended clauses as failures, or describe the paper's excluded or-parallel case. The authors call chronological-first selection practice and show a separate sequential search separator. Neither establishes a universal selection order. The adjacent modes section distinguishes suspension from failure.
